restricted cash: in 35 period(s), 2016-12-31..2026-06-30 the cash line is the filed cash + restricted cash total (CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents, the cash-flow statement's total, read where the annual report filed no CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue for the date); in 35 period(s), 2016-12-31..2026-06-30 no figure separates the restricted part, so where those metrics are computed they still count restricted cash as cash (net cash overstated, net debt understated by the restricted amount; flagged incl_restricted_* and labelled 'some periods incl. restricted cash' on the metric; growth across a change between the two bases is blank)

free cash flow: 5 period(s) (2009-12-31..2011-12-31) report discontinued operations' investing cash flows on their own line, so capex is continuing-only there — FCF and owner's earnings use continuing OCF (NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesContinuingOperations, else OCF − CashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesDiscontinuedOperations from the same filing), blank where neither is filed; the OCF line itself stays the filed total
net margin: continuing net income ÷ revenue for 15 period(s) with discontinued operations (2009-12-31..2014-12-31) — revenue is continuing-only there
